capabilities: Draw freehand strokes, shapes, and floating elements on note surfaces
Edit rendered Markdown text in place in reading and source views
Convert Markdown notes into editable mind maps with bound connectors
Store drawings per note with configurable locations and portable file sharing
Expose a JSON API for scripts, plugins, and AI agents
disambiguation: Not a standalone drawing canvas; ink is stored per note as JSON and rendered as a layer over existing note views.
extras: Author advertises paid custom development at the top of the README. Includes a detailed per-version changelog with bug fixes and migration notes for legacy drawing files.
problem: Obsidian notes cannot be drawn on or edited as rendered text, so annotating means exporting images or switching to separate canvas tools.
